title: Comfy Collab Progress v1
description: Progress update for a running ComfyUI workflow. Carries phase (queued/running/completed/failed), percent complete, current node, and step counters for diffusion-style workflows. Linked to a parent prompt via prompt_id.

room_id.description: Room manifest identifier the workflow is running in.

session_id.description: P7 room session id the workflow belongs to.

prompt_id.description: The prompt this progress update is for. Matches a comfy.collab.prompt.v1.prompt_id.

app_slug.description: Pinokio app slug running the workflow (e.g. comfyui-desktop).

percent.description: Optional 0-100 completion percent. Null when not applicable (queued, failed).

current_node.description: Current ComfyUI node id, when phase=running. Null for non-running phases.

step.description: Current step for diffusion-style workflows. Null when not applicable.

total_steps.description: Total steps planned for the workflow. Null when not applicable.

message.description: Optional human-readable status message (e.g. error reason when phase=failed).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of this progress update.
